plan_review.notes: Alternatives: direct REST-only downloads, workflow progress manifest, and shared cross-instance cloud cache. Kept provider-side gh API plus gh run download because it reuses authenticated extraction and supports existing runs; rejected a workflow manifest because existing runs lack it and Actions artifacts are immutable. Adopted shared artifact caching, full pagination, capability-token HTTP routes, terminal artifact stabilization, branch/repo fallback ordering, selection generation guards, explicit partial/expired states, job-derived expected weapons, redacted actionable errors, and dedicated extension tests.

multi_model_review.adjudication: Round 1: all five findings validated and fixed. Round 2: one shared run-list commit bug validated and fixed; the second report deduplicated into it, with transient response staleness self-healed by SSE. Security review clean in both rounds.
